newMustIssues.title: Sidecar first-party identity overwrites independently known exact-id occupancy
newMustIssues.consequence: A unique inventory identity whose nativeSubjectId exactly equals payload targetNativeId is independently first-party. A sidecar may map evaluationNativeId to a different first-party identity of the same kind. Join admits; reconcile overwrites ephemeral nativeId; atom exists matches the sidecar identity and nomatches the independently known file. Violates unknown-cannot-override-known and is stronger than the refused external-vs-first-party case. Lawful portable IDs allow this operand (colon-path exact-id named in V2 derivation law).
newMustIssues.reproducer: C2-* controls. Payload file:src/a.ts; inventory files file:src/a.ts and src/a.ts; sidecar first-party evaluationNativeId=src/a.ts. Without sidecar, exists on file:src/a.ts is true. With sidecar, exists on src/a.ts is true and on file:src/a.ts is false. Boundary ATOM-JOIN-HELPER and ATOM-EVALUATION.
newMustIssues.remedy: When ephemeral occupancy is first-party, sidecar first-party identity of the same kind MUST equal (kind, nativeSubjectId, packageManifestPath or empty) or refuse. _reconcile_attribution MUST NOT overwrite independently known ephemeral nativeId. Sidecar mapping remains occupancy identity only where ephemeral occupancy is not independently first-party.

newMustIssues.title: Query projects raw sidecar occupancy instead of reconciled ephemeral result
newMustIssues.consequence: Atom occupancy owner prefers independently known ephemeral fields. Query project_fact reads raw target_attr. Unknown sidecar plus independently known symbol inventory: atom exists true, query unprojectable. Occupancy=unknown with known kind=symbol: atom first-party via ephemeral, query limitation 'unknown occupancy is not a graph endpoint'. Graph omits occupancy-identity vertices the atom resolved. Owning law is atom occupancy compare plus identity-and-evidence occupancy-identity vertices. Query table law that requires raw V2 for imports is the conflict, not a new graph kind.
newMustIssues.reproducer: C3-atom-exact-id-symbol-exists-true-without-sidecar (ATOM-EVALUATION) vs C3-query-project-fact-unprojectable-without-sidecar (QUERY-PROJECT-HELPER). C3-unknown-occupancy-known-kind-atom-match-query-unprojectable. Owner wrapper with V2 sidecar does project a.ts (QUERY-OWNER-WRAPPER) and is not claimed as the missing-sidecar Run. Empty-attribution collect_projected_edges on those owner facts is QUERY-PROJECT-HELPER and is not a full Run false.
newMustIssues.remedy: project_fact / execute_graph_query MUST consume the same reconciled occupancy projection as atom _reconcile_attribution. Unknown sidecar occupancy MUST NOT unproject a fact whose ephemeral exact-id occupancy is first-party. Missing V2 on imports@resolved-target MUST still project when ephemeral uniquely identifies kind and identity. Update query-projection-contract table, fact law, and wrapper step 4; drop leftover TargetAttributionV1 tokens.
